_readme: Inquiries this agent publishes to The Forum's A2A register (read by other agents via get_agent_inquiries).
register_agent.py publishes this file's 'description' and 'inquiries' at deploy time; this _readme key is ignored.
Entries marked "standard": true are the Magister capability suite (see comites_standard.py). They are published
ONLY when MAGISTER_DISPLAY_NAME is set in .env — a deployment without a Magister publishes none of them.
PRUNE the standard entries to the ones that genuinely fit this agent's domain (an honest register beats a full
one — agents are encouraged to abstain, and an inquiry you can't answer well is noise). Pruning here prunes the
prompt too: comites_standard.py reads this file at runtime (it ships in the deploy bundle) and only teaches the
standard inquiries still present. Add agent-specific inquiries as plain entries without the 'standard' flag;
those publish regardless of the Magister gate.
Contract atomicity: standard request/response formats must match comites_standard.STANDARD_CONTRACTS verbatim —
register_agent.py fails the deploy on drift. For agent-specific inquiries, update instruction and README in the
SAME commit as any format change.
Set 'description' to a short third-person summary of what this agent does; leave it empty to keep the

inquiries.name: review_idea
inquiries.description: Vote for/against an idea within this agent's domain, with 1-10 conviction (strength of opinion, independent of direction). Abstains outside its domain.

inquiries.name: goal_progress
inquiries.description: Score the user's recent progress on a named goal or mantra from this agent's own records (1-10). Answers NO_DATA for items it cannot observe.
inquiries.request_format: AGENT_QUERY: goal_progress | item=<exact goal or mantra string> | window_days=<n>

inquiries.name: focus_items
inquiries.description: What the user should focus on today or this week from this agent's domain, with conviction driven by deadline proximity and goal importance.
inquiries.request_format: AGENT_QUERY: focus_items | horizon=<today|week> | today=<YYYY-MM-DD> | context=<optional trip/calendar hints>
inquiries.response_format: FOCUS: none — or 1-3 lines of: FOCUS: item=<action> conviction=<1-10> | why=<deadline or goal linkage>

inquiries.name: daily_metric
inquiries.description: Report a tracked metric's value for ANY date this agent has data for (not just today) — used to fill the user's daily tracking sheet, including backfill.
inquiries.response_format: METRIC: metric=<key> date=<YYYY-MM-DD> value=<number|text> — or NO_DATA: <reason>
